# Masizo Development & Restorations

> Masizo Development LLC (trade name: Masizo Development & Restorations) is a
> licensed general contractor and 24/7 restoration company based in Gilbert,
> Arizona, serving the Phoenix East Valley since 1998. Custom homes, remodels,
> room additions, ADUs and casitas, roofing, and emergency water, mold and
> fire damage restoration.

## Business facts

- Legal entity: Masizo Development LLC
- Trade name: Masizo Development & Restorations
- Phone: (602) 909-7630
- Email: office@masizodevelopment.com
- Location: Gilbert, Arizona, USA
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- In business since: 1998
- Website: https://www.masizodevelopment.com

## Licenses and certifications

- AZ ROC #336058 (Arizona Registrar of Contractors — general)
- AZ ROC #347030 (Arizona Registrar of Contractors — restoration)
- CA LIC #1107781 (California Contractors State License Board)
- IICRC certified; insured; BBB A+ accredited
